preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the permutation N must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of good indices K must be between 1 and N.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 200000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(P[i] % (i + 1) == 0 for i in range(N)) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid permutation.

postconditions.expression: sum(P[i] % (i + 1) == 0 for i in range(N)) == K
postconditions.description: The number of good indices in the output permutation must be exactly K.
